BiblicalUsage: Kephel means a duplicate, double. Job 41:13 asks who can come to Leviathan with his double bridle, and Isaiah 40:2 says Jerusalem hath received of the LORD's hand double for all her sins.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe double cuts both ways: double judgment for sin, and double comfort when the warfare is accomplished.
